Title: POST /api/subscribe returns 201 for new valid email
Steps:
POST /api/subscribe
Body: {
  "email": "api.new@example.com"
}
1. Send request
2. Validate status
3. Verify record persisted
Expected Result:
Status 201
201 Created; JSON body; subscriber api.new@example.com persisted exactly once

Title: POST /api/subscribe returns 409 for duplicate email
Expected Result:
Status 409
409 Conflict; error body indicates "Already subscribed"; no new record

Title: Return 400 for invalid email format
Expected Result:
Status 400
400 Bad Request; error body identifies invalid email; nothing persisted

Title: Return 400 when email field is missing
Expected Result:
Status 400
400 Bad Request; error mentions email is required

Title: Return 400 for malformed JSON body
Expected Result:
Status 400
400 Bad Request; no stack trace in body

Title: Reject unsupported method GET on /api/subscribe
Expected Result:
Status 405
405 Method Not Allowed (assumption A4); subscriber list NOT exposed

Title: Reject request with wrong Content-Type
Expected Result:
Status 400
400 Bad Request or 415 Unsupported Media Type (open question Q5); nothing persisted

Title: Concurrent identical requests create one record
Expected Result:
Status 201
Exactly one 201, remaining 409; exactly one DB record (unique constraint holds)

Title: Return 409 for duplicate with different letter case
Rate limiting on repeated subscribe calls
Expected Result:
Status 429
429 Too Many Requests once threshold exceeded (if rate limiting is in scope)

Title: Ignore or reject unknown extra fields
Steps:
POST /api/subscribe
Body: {
  "email": "extra@example.com",
  "isAdmin": true,
  "status": "verified"
}
1. Send request
2. Inspect stored record
Expected Result:
Status 201
201 (or 400 if strict schema); extra fields NOT persisted (no mass assignment)

Title: Accept 100-character email (max)
Expected Result:
Status 201
201 Created; stored email is 100 chars, untruncated

Title: Reject 101-character email (max+1)
Expected Result:
Status 400
400 Bad Request; error indicates max length 100; nothing persisted (server-side enforcement independent of UI)
